title: oven-roasted american lamb kebabs
description: cultural american dish featuring turkish delight and char-grill flavors, without onion or garlic, served on a binchotan-grill
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the binchotan grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place the lamb kebabs on the grill and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the kebabs to a baking sheet and roast in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, heat the Turkish delight in a small saucepan over low heat until melted and fragrant.
Brush the melted Turkish delight over the lamb kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
